text: Angron was the saddest of the Emperor's sons.
He fell to a world of slavers, and was made to fight in the arena.
They hammered the Butcher's Nails into his skull, and took every feeling but rage.
Angron led his fellow slaves in revolt.
Cornered in the mountains, they swore to die together.
Then the Emperor came, and took him away.
He joined Horus, and gave his soul to the Blood God.
He broke his chains, only to become a slave once more.
